dateSource: EXIF DateTimeOriginal calendar dates, read as camera-local timestamps. Pixel offsets are +05:30; Nikon timestamps have no explicit timezone and are retained as recorded.
locationNotes: Place labels come from visible signs and landmarks, camera-local capture order, and the GPS-tagged Pixel photographs along the route. Exact coordinates are not published.
Some Nikon photographs have no GPS and some phone positions appear stale. Broad route or valley labels are used when an exact site cannot be established.
Landmark names were cross-checked against Himachal Tourism destination pages for Shimla, Kinnaur, and Spiti Valley. No separate itinerary was present in the source folder.
criteria: All 765 JPEG photographs reviewed in chronological contact sheets; selected frames reviewed again at larger size.
Scenery, architecture, wildlife, food, and details form the main selection. A small number of candid street, village, visitor, and personal photographs are included for the user to review.
Similar bursts compared and reduced to distinct views; blurred, severely underexposed, obstructed, and accidental frames omitted.
The cover is not repeated in the gallery. Original framing and colour retained; web exports have no EXIF or XMP.
The two source videos are outside the photo album. The 20 Delhi photographs from 24–25 September are outside this Himalayan story and are omitted.
Short arrival and return days use fewer photographs rather than filling the album with repeated views.
